scope: English Black & White foil wrapper reverse research
notes: Dimensions describe the full source photograph, not effective wrapper resolution.
Visual identification by English expansion copy and pack configuration; seller authenticity is not independently certified.

sources.name: Black & White
sources.review: Complete empty Reshiram wrapper; readable printing; wrinkles and photographed highlights remain.

sources.name: Emerging Powers
sources.review: Readable Cobalion reverse in PSA slab; horizontal holder rails cross seal transitions. Needs unobstructed source.

sources.name: Noble Victories
sources.review: Complete empty wrapper on dark background; readable expansion text; creases and bright foil reflections remain. Prefer this over the tightly clipped Hydreigon photograph.

sources.name: Next Destinies
sources.review: Complete Mewtwo wrapper on gray surface; readable printing and intact seals; creases remain.

sources.name: Dark Explorers
sources.review: Readable Darkrai reverse in PSA slab; holder rails cross the pack near both seals. Needs unobstructed source.

sources.name: Dragons Exalted
sources.review: Readable Gyarados reverse in sleeve; display stand tabs obscure bottom seal and sleeve adds reflections. Needs unobstructed source.

sources.name: Dragon Vault
sources.review: Salamence five-card reverse, correctly without ordinary booster barcode; dark foil photographed through PSA holder. Rails and glare prevent clean texture use.

sources.name: Boundaries Crossed
sources.review: Readable White Kyurem reverse; PSA holder rails cross printing near both seals and glare is baked in. Needs unobstructed source.

sources.name: Plasma Storm
sources.review: Complete readable Lugia reverse; PSA holder rails cross print and there are strong specular streaks. Infernape alternative also has rails. Earlier loose wrapper had a missing torn corner.

sources.name: Plasma Freeze
sources.review: Complete reverse on gray surface; readable printing; pronounced foil creases and diagonal glare require live review after cropping.

sources.name: Plasma Blast
sources.review: Complete close Porygon-Z reverse on red background; readable expansion copy; strong candidate for measured perspective crop.

sources.name: Legendary Treasures
sources.review: Complete readable Mewtwo reverse; folded top corner and foil reflections remain; seller watermark is outside wrapper.
